answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a digital juniper tree, anchoring the network’s integrity before the dawn of any consensus round. By requiring agents to lock collateral as a haven for economic security, the system mandates that identity is linked to capital. An attacker seeking to flood the network with fake nodes must acquire a majority of total supply, making the cost of a Sybil attack prohibitively expensive and economically irrational, thus ensuring the decentralization of the validator set.
